title: Merchants seen
statementMd:
List the distinct merchants that appear in the ledger (ignore NULL).

Expected columns: `merchant`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT merchant FROM transactions WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
